title: Khan Academy Basics
subtitle: Find a subject, open a lesson, and try practice
description: Get comfortable on Khan Academy — Teachy coaches you toward each goal using whatever the site looks like today.
learningOutcomes: Open Khan Academy in a browser
Browse or search for a subject
Open a lesson, video, or article
Start a practice exercise if one is available
Find your way back to courses or the homepage

goals.title: Open Khan Academy
goals.goal: Have Khan Academy open in a browser so you can start learning.
goals.coachAsk: Help me get Khan Academy open in my browser and show me where I'd start exploring.
goals.doneWhen: Khan Academy is open and recognizable as the Khan Academy site.
tips: Signing in is optional for exploring

goals.title: Find a subject
goals.goal: Browse or search until you land on a subject or topic area you care about.
goals.coachAsk: How do I find a subject on Khan Academy — like math, science, or something else I'm into? Point at what I should use.
goals.doneWhen: A subject, course, or topic listing is visible (not just the generic marketing homepage).

goals.title: Open a lesson
goals.goal: Open a lesson, video, or article so learning content is on screen.
goals.coachAsk: How do I open an actual lesson or video from here? Point at what I should click.
goals.doneWhen: A lesson, video player, article, or unit content page is open.
tips: Any lesson in the subject is fine

goals.title: Try practice
goals.goal: Start a practice exercise, quiz, or interactive problem — or clearly find where practice lives if one isn't available yet.
goals.coachAsk: I'd like to try a practice problem on Khan Academy. Point at how I start practice or an exercise from here.
goals.doneWhen: A practice exercise, quiz, or problem UI is visible, or the learner has confirmed they found where practice lives and are done trying.
tips: If this lesson has no practice, finding the practice entry point still counts

goals.title: Find your way around
goals.goal: Navigate back to courses, subjects, or the Khan Academy homepage.
goals.coachAsk: How do I get back to courses or the Khan Academy homepage from here? Point at what I should use.
goals.doneWhen: The learner is on a main courses/subjects area or the Khan Academy homepage (not stuck inside one lesson).
tips: Logo and main navigation are common patterns — use whatever exists today
